Categories.Title: Mythic Affix
Categories.Blurb: New in Relics. The Standard of Heroes, forged from an Ancient's statue and the five Worldstone Shards, turns a magic or rare item Mythic: one Exalted affix on top of what it has.

Categories.Title: Runes
Categories.Blurb: Three low runes make the next one, from Pul on it takes two. In Relics the runes alone are enough; the game also asks for a gem.

Categories.Title: Gems
Categories.Blurb: Three of a grade make one of the next, chipped to perfect.

Categories.Title: Crafting
Categories.Blurb: A magic item, a jewel, a rune and a perfect gem make a crafted item with fixed affixes on top of random ones - and a small chance at an Exalted affix.

Categories.Title: Sockets
Categories.Blurb: Punching sockets into what has none, and clearing them again.

Categories.Title: Upgrading
Categories.Blurb: A unique, rare or set item moves to the next base tier and keeps its affixes; low quality becomes normal.

Categories.Title: Rerolls & Jewelry
Categories.Blurb: New affixes for an old item, rings into amulets and back, and the old jewelry recipes.

Categories.Title: Repair
Categories.Blurb: Durability and charges back without a visit to town.

Categories.Title: Quests, Keys & Portals
Categories.Blurb: Quest items assembled, the Pandemonium keys and organs, the Worldstone and the Ancients.

Categories.Title: Potions & Odds and Ends
Categories.Blurb: Rejuvenation from the stock in your belt, and a few oddities from the old days.
